scenes.text: Offshore and onshore, integrity teams still run on paper, on spreadsheets, and on the last bar of signal. The well does not wait for the office.
When the connection drops, the measurement survives. The evidence does not. Decisions wait for a report that never gets written, and the next inspection repeats the same trip.
IntegrityWatch Field is an offline-first integrity and compliance centre. It runs entirely on the tablet. No server, no cloud, no connection, and nothing to synchronise before you can decide.
Import a field CSV. The app detects the delimiter, maps the columns, validates every row and commits the readings on the device. Thirty two rows, zero skipped.
Register the asset from real line data, set the risk band, and let the app calculate the inspection interval.
Then generate the point dossier on the same device. Real line attributes in. A document you can print, sign and defend.
IntegrityWatch Field. Field data, field decisions, no signal required.
